fact: In August 2026 the Egyptian Tax Authority began applying the real estate transactions system through a mobile app: the citizen registers the property, uploads the sale contract, sees the 2.5% tax due, pays it electronically and obtains an electronic clearance, first phase for Greater Cairo and Alexandria.
title: من الموبايل.. تطبيق جديد من الضرائب ينجز الإجراءات الضريبية لبيع العقارات
